# Which roles answer the air inside a component's own parts?

Read this when your style plugin answers the padding, the gap or an edge of a part inside a component.

`grid-min` reads no scale at all, and a literal is the only answer for it.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

Only Arena's components read the roles on this page. A role keeps its name until a major release, and its value is the style plugin's to change in any release.

| role | question | type | user scale | default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--board-column-lg` | How narrow may a column of a board get at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--board-column-md` | How narrow may a column of a board get at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--board-column-sm` | How narrow may a column of a board get at the sm size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--bw-surface-head` | How thick is the rule between the head of a surface and its body? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--dialog-width-lg` | How wide is the panel of a dialog at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--dialog-width-md` | How wide is the panel of a dialog at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--dialog-width-sm` | How wide is the panel of a dialog at the sm size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--gap-marker` | How far apart are the parts of a marker, such as a dot and its label? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--gap-row-floating` | How far apart are the icon, label and shortcut of a row in a floating list? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--grid-max-lg` | How wide may a grid run at the lg size before it centres? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--grid-max-md` | How wide may a grid run at the md size before it centres? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--grid-max-sm` | How wide may a grid run at the sm size before it centres? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--grid-min` | How narrow may a column of an auto-filling grid get before the grid drops one? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--grid-min-lg` | How narrow may a column of a grid get at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--grid-min-sm` | How narrow may a column of a grid get at the sm size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-band-x` | How much room does an app bar band leave at each end? | dimension | fixed | `{gutter}` |
| `--pad-band-y` | How much room does an app bar band give its content down? | dimension | fixed | `{sp.3}` |
| `--pad-floating-edge-x` | How much room does a sheet pinned to a viewport edge give its content across? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-floating-x` | How much room does a dialog, menu or popover give its content across? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-floating-y` | How much room does a dialog, menu or popover give its content down? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-key-y` | How much room does a keyboard key cap give its label down? | dimension | fixed | `{sp.0-5}` |
| `--pad-marker-x` | How much room does a badge, chip or tag give its label across? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-marker-y` | How much room does a badge, chip or tag give its label down? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-nav-row-x` | How much room does a side nav row give its content across? | dimension | fixed | `{pad-row-x}` |
| `--pad-nav-row-y` | How much room does a side nav row give its content down? | dimension | fixed | `{pad-row-y}` |
| `--pad-row-floating-x` | How much room does a row of a floating list give its content across? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-row-floating-y` | How much room does a row of a floating list give its content down? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-status-x` | How much room does an alert, toast or empty state give its message across? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-status-y` | How much room does an alert, toast or empty state give its message down? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--scroller-item-lg` | How wide is each item of a scroller at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--scroller-item-md` | How wide is each item of a scroller at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--scroller-item-sm` | How wide is each item of a scroller at the sm size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--timeline-dot` | How wide is the dot of a timeline milestone? | dimension | fixed | `{sp.5}` |
